description: This file defines the WorkshopController class which manages the display of workshop-related views. It includes methods to show a specific workshop's landing page, fetch related workshops, and sponsors.

classes.name: WorkshopController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing the workshop views and related interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller and sets the theme for views.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the display of a specific workshop, its related workshops, and sponsors based on the provided ID.
